criterion_origin.source: Selected after viewing v3 matched-FREE posthoc analysis

budget.hard_stop: Sum command-wall stages including parallel agents and GPU process-wall. Reallocations within overall limits allowed; no extensions. Preserve partial results and mark NOT_EVALUABLE.

registration.mechanism: Commit and push exact protocol before new data construction/download, retraining or eval access; bind commit and hash. Development confirmation; not protected FINAL or App inheritance.

features.readout: unchanged v1 peak_readout SNR>=3 coverage>=.75 and projection; no source native/reference/labels/categories/groundtruth depths used as features
features.margin: 16th largest min(z-entry,exit-z) over query-domain finite positive predicted rays; less16 finite rays -> -inf
features.ToF_K: ordinary features arithmetic mean; either missing margin -> baseline -inf and model margin -10 with missingflag1; valid_K_count0/1/2
features.ToF_relationship: before z<entry, inside entry<=z<=exit, after z>exit; fractions divided by query-domain rays; median offsets to entry/exit over finite positive rays, absent=-10
features.support: projected pixel-ray count with predicted depth inside query, not independent subrays
features.RGB: DAV2 and UniDepth own raw margin16, missing indicator, finite-domain fraction
features.query_indices: Remove band_index and all query_x/y/z_index. No explicit position, distance band, domain size or arm identity as model features. Band used only for thresholds/report. Sensor interval-relative margins retained; no causal removal-of-all-priors claim.
features.evidence_gate: For D_prime/B_prime/audit_b: finite unclipped raw ToF margin>=0 OR active RGB margin>=0; ToF K2 mean any missing K gives -inf; active RGB Uni near/DAV midfar. No evidence -> score -inf before cal ties/eval prediction. Minimum geometric support definition identical audit(b).

models.final: Bytewise identical v3 D_prime three weights; no final refit
models.ensemble: arithmetic probability mean then unchanged evidence gate

data.selection: Official metadata order; globally exclude entire consumed visits including v3 and failed gates. First time-complete upsampling capture per visit, first4 accepted cal and next16 eval, skip records retained; no migration.
data.windows: v3 exact two disjoint16-frame5Hz windows fixed before labels
data.admission_gate: v3 exact near POS>=16 and midfar strict FREE>=32 across32frames; reference-only gate, no predictor metrics. Entire rejected visit consumed.
data.observation_eval: Observation-only eval features allowed before OPEN; reference gate only before sole OPEN

ToF.native: v1.1 fixed residual pool, optical-Z bands [.3,.8),[.8,1.5),[1.5,3); independently sample pixel residuals with fixed seeds, invalid/nonpositive/outside range UNKNOWN; no native fill of FARO

Quality arms use FARO geometry, missing rows retained, no native fill; .5/2 signal or3/10 ambient scaling from base photon expectation with frozen sample and same frame/K seeds. ToF.readout: Frozen v1 SNR>=3, zonecoverage>=.75, 16-order margin; same DAV/Uni frozenrawmodels, no model/readout edits

scores.baselines: Same v3 raw scores, OR=max and AND=min; same six arms and per-band cuts

crossfit.fold_assignment: Sorted old visit_ids permuted by numpy default_rng(20261011), then array_split into5 blocks6; no label stratification
crossfit.fit: Same v3 D_prime HGB recipe seeds955/956/957, first16 sensor features, known labels only; each train fold equal6-arm total weights n_known/(6*n_arm_known). OOF predictions for all held-out rows inclUNKNOWN; unchanged evidence gate.
crossfit.purpose: OOF scores only for cal thresholds; eval uses bytewise frozen v3 D_prime
crossfit.distribution_check: OOF vs frozen v3 on same old30 rows by arm/band/label, finite fractions, quantiles and paired differences. Frozen old30 comparison is in-sample. New4 cal use frozen v3. No probability remapping to repair mismatch.

calibration.threshold_rule: score>=threshold; all finite unique score ties plus +inf all-reject; -inf is never candidate
calibration.objective: among F<=floor(target*FREE), maximize query W on POS, then minimize F, then choose highest threshold; no tie splitting
calibration.zero_FREE: threshold+inf, status NOT_CALIBRATABLE; never count as success
calibration.zero_POS: threshold+inf, status NO_CAL_POS; never count as success
calibration.mixture: Concatenate available six-arm rows fromold30OOF+new4cal; FARObase fixedgate; baselines old30raw+new4raw; sharedcut per method/band.

metric_contract.W: query-level predicted positive AND POS reference; not old pixel-intersection witness; all methods same
metric_contract.U: predicted positive AND UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN excluded from fitting, included in eval support report
metric_contract.no_pixel_claim: learner emits query probability only; legacy pixel-witness numbers not directly comparable

eval.single_open: Exclusive eval_open.json after complete20 cohort, crossfit/cal seal and independent preOPEN audit PASS; produce immutable label/score/pred cache once. AfterOPEN no weights/cut changes or label/model rereads; cache-only statistics.

bootstrap.cluster: Resample all16original eval visit IDs with paired multiplicities, retain zero-row FARO clusters
bootstrap.recompute: Recompute whole-tie weighted curve and normalized partial area each draw
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile; omit zeroPOS/FREE draws and reportvalidcount; primary requires all2000valid
bootstrap.comparisons: Fixed D-RGB and D-OR both must pass; no postoutcome arm/band selection

eval.forbidden: Protected480/test never accessed; incompleteOPEN cannot reopen, preserve NOT_EVALUABLE

pauc.normalization: Integral divided by.05; W/POS andF/FREE proportions, normalizedscore0..1
pauc.ties: Finite unique score ties plusdisabled+inf, -inf unavailable; each exactreachableF retain maxW, nointerp nor ties splitting.
pauc.curve: Right-continuous attainable-budget step R(x)=max W/POS over whole-tie points withF/FREE<=x. Absorb sameF vertical jumps into maxW, then hold level untilnextF. MaxW atF0 starts x0; lastsegment flat to.05. Not trapezoidal ROC.

confirmation.criterion: Complete20 newvisit cohort cal4/eval16, native middlePOS/FREE>0; bothD_prime-minus-rgb andD_prime-minus-or normalizedpAUC 95%bootstrap lower>0, all2000primary drawsvalid
confirmation.pass_claim: 冻结 D′ 在中带低误报区间的排序优于 RGB-only 与 OR（真实 RGB + 半合成 ToF，新 visit 预注册）

confirmation.report: All6arms/3bands pAUC/interval,deployment,drift; highlightFARO/ambient10 descriptiveonly. Comparev3 original6visitcal thresholds on samev4eval as prespecified driftcontrol; preserveoriginalv3results.

retry.before_open: Resume source/feature mechanical interruptions with unchanged selected windows/roles/recipes, preserve failures and hashes; failed fixed fit may mechanically rerun only before outcome access with cause receipt, not a new recipe
retry.after_open: Exclusive open marker; cache query predictions/labels once. No second label/model pass. If incomplete, preserve terminal and report NOT_EVALUABLE; cached summaries/audits may resume unchanged.
